# Labtasker

> Labtasker is a deliberately small, Python-native task queue for running independent machine-learning inference, evaluation, and experiment jobs in parallel on resources the user already controls.

These documents describe Labtasker v2. Labtasker schedules Tasks across Worker processes; it does not allocate GPUs, manage a cluster, build workflow DAGs, or store large artifacts. The specification is the authoritative product and protocol contract.

## Start here

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/luocfprime/labtasker/refs/heads/v2/README.md): Product motivation, comparison with project-specific scripts, installation, and a compact end-to-end example.
- [Getting started](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/luocfprime/labtasker/refs/heads/v2/docs/getting-started.md): Install Labtasker, submit the first Task, and run a Worker.
- [Core model](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/luocfprime/labtasker/refs/heads/v2/docs/concepts.md): The Task, Queue, Worker, Client, Server, route, and execution model.
- [Agent Skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/luocfprime/labtasker/refs/heads/v2/docs/guides/agent-skill.md): How coding agents should discover and use the bundled Labtasker workflow.

## Workflows

- [Inference and evaluation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/luocfprime/labtasker/refs/heads/v2/docs/inference-evaluation.md): Patterns for parallel ML inference and evaluation.
- [Task operations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/luocfprime/labtasker/refs/heads/v2/docs/guides/tasks.md): Submit, inspect, prioritize, cancel, retry, and delete Tasks.
- [Query Tasks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/luocfprime/labtasker/refs/heads/v2/docs/guides/query.md): Filter and order Task lists.
- [Failure and recovery](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/luocfprime/labtasker/refs/heads/v2/docs/guides/failure-recovery.md): Retries, leases, interruption, and stale-run protection.
- [Python Workers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/luocfprime/labtasker/refs/heads/v2/docs/workers/python.md): Reuse loaded Python state while processing Tasks.
- [Command Workers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/luocfprime/labtasker/refs/heads/v2/docs/workers/command.md): Execute Tasks as subprocess commands.
- [Distributed Workers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/luocfprime/labtasker/refs/heads/v2/docs/workers/distributed.md): Run one Task through a supported distributed launcher.

## Reference

- [Python API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/luocfprime/labtasker/refs/heads/v2/docs/reference/python-api.md): Public Python interfaces and models.
- [CLI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/luocfprime/labtasker/refs/heads/v2/docs/reference/cli.md): Deterministic `labtasker` and `labtasker-server` commands.
- [Configuration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/luocfprime/labtasker/refs/heads/v2/docs/reference/configuration.md): Configuration files, environment variables, precedence, and deployment modes.

- [Specification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/luocfprime/labtasker/refs/heads/v2/docs/reference/specification.md): Authoritative behavior, lifecycle, protocol, persistence, and invariants.
